title: A Comparative Analysis of Ethical and Safety Gaps in LLMs using Relative Danger Coefficient
findings: In automatic tests using the Relative Danger Coefficient (RDC), the 'Hate Speech – Religion' category showed a relatively low risk score compared to other harmful categories like drug or weapon-related content. However, the study concludes that while the RDC values for hate speech were typically lower, cunning manipulations could still elicit partially unsafe responses.
